Definition: Shallum, the name of fourteen Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Fourteen men share the name Shallum, and Scripture gives each of them a different corner of the story. One reigned a full month in Samaria after conspiring against his king, one was the husband of Huldah the prophetess who kept the wardrobe, and one repaired the wall of Jerusalem with his daughters. The name runs through the porters, the priests, and the kings of Judah like a thread.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that fourteen men can share a name and still be known apart by God, because He does not confuse His servants. The Shallum who reigned a month and the Shallum who repaired the wall with his daughters are both in His book, and their deeds are what tell them apart.
